Package index

Data Aquisition

htr_download_ESM()
Download Earth System Model (ESM) data using wget scripts
htr_shift_years()
Shift time coordinates in climate model data

Temporal Data Preparation

htr_merge_files()
Merge climate model files into continuous time series
htr_slice_period()
Extract specific time periods from climate model data
htr_fix_calendar()
Fix calendar systems by standardizing to 365-day calendar

Temporal Processing

htr_change_freq()
Change temporal frequency of climate data
htr_seasonal_frequency()
Convert climate data to seasonal frequency

Spatial Processing

htr_regrid_esm()
Regrid Earth System Model outputs to a common spatial grid

Depth-resolved Processing

htr_integrate_levels()
Calculate vertical means from depth-resolved climate data
htr_show_levels()
Display vertical levels in depth-resolved climate data

Statistical Analysis

htr_calc_mean()
Calculate temporal mean of specified time period
htr_calc_anomalies()
Calculate anomalies relative to the baseline mean
htr_create_ensemble()
Create multi-model ensemble from climate model outputs

Utility Functions

htr_make_folder()
Create directory if it doesn't exist
